title: Finite-width shift of the edge of chaos in deep neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.06582v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep neural networks train best when they are initialised at the edge of chaos, the critical line in the plane of weight and bias variances on which the distance between two inputs neither grows nor shrinks with depth. The line is known for infinitely wide networks; at finite width it moves, and how it moves has been disputed. We treat the logarithm of the distance between two inputs through a network of width $N$ as a random walk and compute its drift and variance to order $1/N$. The edge of chaos moves to a larger weight variance, by $\Delta\sigma_w^2=-a_1/(N\,\partial_{\sigma_w^2}\ln\chi_1)$, about $8/N$ for $\tanh$ networks at a bias variance of $0.05$, confirmed by simulations of the exact finite-width recursion. The shift describes a typical network; the average over many networks is dominated by rare networks in which the distance grows, and its critical point moves the other way, which explains why calculations and simulations

translated_title: 深度神经网络中混沌边缘的有限宽度偏移
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.06582v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：深度神经网络在“混沌边缘”初始化时训练效果最佳——混沌边缘是权重方差与偏置方差平面上的一条临界线，在这条线上两个输入之间的距离既不随深度增长也不随深度收缩。这条临界线在无限宽网络中是已知的；在有限宽度下它会移动，而它如何移动一直存在争议。我们将两个输入经过宽度为 $N$ 的网络后距离的对数视为随机游走，并计算其漂移和方差至 $1/N$ 阶。混沌边缘移动到更大的权重方差处，移动量为 $\Delta\sigma_w^2=-a_1/(N\,\partial_{\sigma_w^2}\ln\chi_1)$，对于偏置方差为 $0.05$ 的 $\tanh$ 网络约为 $8/N$，这已通过对精确有限宽度递推关系的模拟得到证实。该偏移描述的是典型网络；而对多个网络取平均时，结果由少数距离增长的稀有网络主导，其临界点向相反方向移动，这解释了为什么理论计算与模拟（结果存在分歧）……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将两输入距离的对数建模为随机游走，精确计算出有限宽度下深度神经网络的混沌边缘向更大权重方差方向偏移（tanh网络约为8/N），并解释了典型网络与网络平均的临界点移动方向相反这一长期争议。
en_tdlr: By modeling the logarithm of the distance between two inputs as a random walk, this paper computes the finite-width shift of the edge of chaos in deep neural networks—moving to larger weight variance by about 8/N for tanh networks—and resolves why network-averaged critical points move in the opposite direction.
